verdict.rationale: Ramp MCP lets employees "get policy answers directly from their daily tools" through assistants like ChatGPT and Claude, and the AI Agents guide lists policy Q&A among its capabilities. Missing-receipt chasing is documented in several places: the MCP prompt "find transactions with missing receipts... draft reminder messages," the CLI's transactions missing / flag-missing / explain-missing commands, automatic reminders, and SMS/Slack/Teams receipt submission. The core of the story is delivered, but explaining card declines conversationally is not documented anywhere. missing for 10: evidence of conversational explanation of declines, concrete documentation of pre-spend "can I expense this?" answers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
